user.title: Create a CDA Alarm panel
user.description: Choose the name shown for this alarm panel.

error.invalid_codes: Codes must be a JSON array of objects containing only name, pin, rfid, and nfc_tag_id string fields.

init.title: CDA Alarm options
init.description: Select all sensors once, then set delays and codes. On the next screen you choose Away / Home / Night for each sensor. Codes JSON example: [{"name":"Alice","pin":"1234","rfid":"tag-id","nfc_tag_id":"home-assistant-tag-id"}].

data.block_arm_if_open: Block arming when a sensor is open

data_description.sensors: Any entities that should arm the alarm (doors, windows, motion, etc.). Modes are assigned on the next step.
data_description.entry_delay: Seconds allowed before the alarm triggers.
data_description.exit_delay: Seconds allowed to leave after arming.
data_description.frient_device_id: Optional ZHA Frient keypad used by this alarm.
data_description.keypad_endpoint: Zigbee endpoint used for keypad feedback.
data_description.codes_json: JSON array of objects. Supported string fields are name, pin, rfid, and nfc_tag_id.

assign_modes.title: Sensor modes
assign_modes.description: For each sensor, select the arm modes that monitor it. Leave all unchecked to ignore that sensor.
